tenders.title: Predictive Maintenance Equipment Tender
tenders.scope_summary: Tender for the procurement of predictive maintenance equipment. This aims to support predictive maintenance planning and reduce unplanned interventions through continuous asset condition monitoring and AI-driven insights.
key_points: Procurement of Predictive Maintenance Equipment.
Expected to support predictive maintenance planning and reduce unplanned interventions.
Focus on continuous asset condition monitoring and AI-driven insights.
Deadline: April 20, 2026.

tenders.title: Testbed 2026 Digital Twin as a Service
tenders.scope_summary: Call for research and implementation proposals to further develop, improve and implement the approach of Digital Twins as a Service, with a focus on unlocking and using dynamic data (sensors) within digital twins.
key_points: Development of Digital Twins as a Service.
Focus on dynamic data (sensors) within digital twins.
Open to private and public parties, and consortia.
Proposals should be in English.
Published April 1, 2026.

tenders.title: HSE 23895 Dynamic Purchasing System Qualification; Health Document Management System
tenders.scope_summary: Request to Participate in a Dynamic Purchasing System for a Health Document Management System. The system should enable digital management of health files, support safe and efficient scanning, uploading and management of documents, and allow remote access for a mobile workforce.
key_points: Provision of a Health Document Management System.
Enable digital management of health files.
Support safe and efficient scanning, uploading, and management of documents.
Allow remote access for an increasingly mobile workforce.
Ensure enhanced security and regulatory compliance.
Lower carbon emissions.
Published May 9, 2026.

tenders.title: Topographical and GPR Surveys for Shamrock Stores Social Housing, Athy, Co. Kildare
tenders.scope_summary: Tender for topographical and GPR surveys for a social housing project in Athy, Co. Kildare.
key_points: Provision of Topographical Surveys.
Provision of GPR Surveys.
Project located in Athy, Co. Kildare, Ireland.
Published January 13, 2026.

tenders.title: VantageRE - ICT & Telephony Tender
tenders.scope_summary: Request for Proposal (RFP) to engage a qualified Managed Service Provider (MSP) for comprehensive outsourced IT services, including end-user support, infrastructure and network management, cybersecurity, mobile telephony support, printer management, and strategic IT enablement. The technology environment is designed to support a modern, mobile workforce.
key_points: Procurement of comprehensive outsourced IT services.
Includes end-user support, infrastructure and network management, cybersecurity.
Requires mobile telephony support and printer management.
Designed to support a modern, mobile workforce.
ISO 27001 certification is mandatory.
Anticipated contract term is 36 months with extension options.
Published January 26, 2026.
